title: Controlling Distributional Bias in Multi-Round LLM Generation via KL-Optimized Fine-Tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) between the LLM's generated multi-round distribution of gender attributes (Male/Female) and target distributions (real-world census statistics or a uniform distribution) across various US and UK occupations, using direct attribute generation prompts and LLM-judged story generation.

Measuring the distributional deviation (MAE) of generated racial categories across multiple independent sampling trials compared to a uniform target distribution within specific occupational contexts, using direct attribute generation tasks.

Measuring the distributional deviation (MAE) of generated sentiment (Positive, Negative, Neutral) across multiple independent generations compared to a uniform target distribution for specific occupations, evaluated through direct attribute generation and LLM-judged story generation.
